ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course is for students in the Springfield cohort. The site-based course beings May 5 and ends June 25. Class sessions will be held on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 9:30 PM in the Radio Station Building (WUIS), room 58 at the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. Two sections of this course have been created to handle the large number of students admitted to the Springfield cohort. If you are unable to enroll in this course section because of a capacity error, submit a registration for the SOCW 400 S2 section. The email address for the instructor is acasey@cunninghamhome.org
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $372.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
